issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing calc_val to return the value 42 in the EAX register, but the solution implementation places the return value in EBX (mov ebx, 42). This contradicts the specified calling/return convention and will confuse students about which register must hold the function result.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution implementation of calc_val to place 42 into EAX (e.g. replace 'mov ebx, 42' with 'mov eax, 42') so it matches the problem specification that the function returns 42 in EAX.
